verdict.rationale: BigCommerce's official Tools & SDKs page offers API clients for making requests "in the language of your choice," plus an official Checkout SDK (checkout-sdk-js) and an open-source design system for building native control-panel apps. These sit alongside the Catalyst Next.js framework and documented REST/GraphQL APIs. missing for 10: the evidence does not list which languages the API clients cover or show how mature or maintained they are, and there is no independent or hands-on corroboration of the SDKs in use.
